militantes.metaDescricao: The Lúcia Revolutionary Front, of the Instituto Lúcia, is calling for militant volunteers. Free sign-up, for people aged 18 or over.
militantes.titulo: We are calling for militant volunteers
militantes.lead: The Instituto Lúcia is a people's school, a free library and, now, also a political movement. The Lúcia Maria Revolutionary School educates; the Front organizes. Come with us.
porque: Because knowledge belongs to the people, and no one should pay to learn.
Because no right was ever handed out as a gift: everything the working class has was won through struggle.
Because learning together is organizing solidarity, and no one frees themselves alone.
Because organized study changes the world.
militantes.frentesTexto: Each militant chooses where they add the most: education, communication, translation, proofreading, mediation, art and outreach, development, curation. The list is the same as for volunteering: militants work too.

passos.texto: Fill in the form below. You do not need an account on the site.
The coordination reads every sign-up and answers at the e-mail you give.
Those who join study at the Lúcia Maria Revolutionary School, with the manifesto as a starting point.
You get a front of work and start organizing, with the team by your side.

militantes.cuidadoTexto: Saying you want to join a political front reveals your political opinion, which Brazilian law calls sensitive data (LGPD, art. 5, II). That is why we ask for your consent separately, keep only what is needed to answer, and only the coordination sees it. You can ask at any time for your sign-up to be deleted.
militantes.formLead: Take your time. The coordination reads every sign-up and answers at the e-mail you give.
militantes.formMensagem: Introduction: tell us who you are, what you already do in the struggle (if anything) and why you want to join
militantes.formEnviado: Sign-up received. Welcome to the struggle: the coordination will read it and answer at the e-mail you gave.
militantes.formPrivacidade: Your name, e-mail, Instagram and sign-up are seen only by the coordination and are used only to answer you and organize the militancy. Nothing is sold or passed on to third parties.
militantes.consentimento: I agree that the Instituto Lúcia keeps this sign-up, which shows my political opinion, only so the coordination can answer me and organize the militancy of the Lúcia Revolutionary Front. I know I can ask for it to be deleted whenever I want.
militantes.menor: Under 18? The militant sign-up is only for adults. You can study at the School and on the site as much as you like, and come back here when you turn 18.
militantes.manifestoTexto: The initial version of the Front's manifesto, under discussion: what we denounce, what we believe in and what we do.
